question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. **Erudite**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Uninformed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Erudite"** means having or showing great knowledge or learning; highly educated and scholarly. (विद्वान)
 
 
• **Example:** The professor's erudite lectures were admired by all the students.
 
 
• **"Uninformed"** refers to someone lacking knowledge or awareness in general or about a particular subject. (अज्ञानी)
 
 
• **Example:** The uninformed audience failed to grasp the depth of the topic being discussed.
